focus: CLI core: transport-neutral dispatch, argument errors as results, a separate entry, config path isolation, exit codes and signal cleanup
keyQuestions: How can dispatchToolCall be made transport-neutral and shared by the CLI and the MCP server while argument errors return as CLI results?
answeredQuestions: How can dispatchToolCall be made transport-neutral and shared by the CLI and the MCP server while argument errors return as CLI results?

label: Transport-neutral dispatch is live: dispatchTool in runtime/src/core/dispatch.ts:105-162 takes a definitions map, a ToolContext, a name and unknown args, returns a discriminated DispatchOutcome, and imports no transport value beyond the type CallToolResult at line 20.

Argument errors return as results on the CLI and stay protocol errors on MCP: dispatchOutcomeErrorResult builds an isError result with code INVALID_INPUT and details.issues (dispatch.ts:170-187), the CLI prints it and exits 2 (cli.ts:206-214), and the MCP handler keeps McpError MethodNotFound and InvalidParams (tool-registry.ts:134-148).

A separate CLI entry exists with a self-run guard at runtime/src/cli.ts:464-478, while runtime/src/index.ts:126 still executes void main() at module scope, so importing the MCP entry would start a stdio server.

Tool argv never reaches loadConfig: configTokens (cli.ts:216-246) emits only --allowed-dir and --output-dir tokens plus MEDIA_EDITOR_* environment values, and tool arguments travel through --args, --args-file or stdin, which matters because parseArguments still turns bare tokens into allowed-root candidates (config.ts:155-175).

Exit codes form a stable table: 0 success and 1 tool failure (cli.ts:388-389), 2 usage and dispatch errors (cli.ts:196-214), 3 startup failures (cli.ts:452-461, 468-477), 130 or 143 on SIGINT or SIGTERM (cli.ts:310).

Signal cleanup is real: armSignalHandlers (cli.ts:307-320) calls terminateAll before exiting, terminateAll (process-runner.ts:737-770) SIGTERMs live children, waits a grace window, SIGKILLs, then removes every path tracked by registerCleanupPath (process-runner.ts:705-725), and the preview sink registers its temporary and target paths (cli.ts:290-291).

The dispatch packet's path instruction is stale against the live tree: it says the folder is still named mcp server/ but AI Systems/Media Editor/ holds runtime/ with the rename staged in git (RM mcp server/... -> runtime/... entries in git status --short, runtime/ mtime 2026-10-04 15:53 local), so this lineage cites runtime/.
